name: idwt
setup: x = (1:8)'; xL = (1:16)'; [Lo_D, Hi_D, Lo_R, Hi_R] = wfilters('db2'); [cA, cD] = dwt(x, 'db2'); [cA4, cD4] = dwt(xL, 'db4');
expr: xr = idwt(cA, cD, 'db2'); xr4 = idwt(cA4, cD4, 'db4'); xr_cust = idwt(cA, cD, Lo_R, Hi_R); xr_len = idwt(cA, cD, 'db2', 8);
comment: Sig: x = idwt(cA, cD, wname) or (cA, cD, Lo_R, Hi_R), optional positional `len` and 'mode' N-V (only 'sym' supported). After wfilters label-swap fix + dwt downsample-offset fix, round-trip is bit-identical to MATLAB R2025b at ~1e-12. Custom synthesis-filter form added in the same commit.
